div.head: Iudex 7
div.ab: Qui innocentem opprimit et dimittit noxium pro pecunia uel amicitia uel odio uel quacumque factione, opprimetur ab omnipotente iudice.
Se þe þam unscyldigan sceððeþ, oððe þam scyldegan scyldeþ for metsceattum oðð for æniges mannes lufan oððe feonge, he biþ eft geniðerad fram ðam ecan deman.
Whoever harms the guiltless or shields the guilty for money, or for hatred or love of any man, he will afterwards be condemned by the eternal judge.
Wer dem Unschuldigen schadet oder den Schuldigen schirmt für Lohngelder oder aus Liebe oder Hass zu jemandem, der wird später verdammt werden von dem ewigen Richter.
Whoever harms the innocent or shields the guilty for bribes or out of love or hatred for anyone will later be condemned by the eternal Judge.
